claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a blue "AIG BROTHER" sewing machine; no clear evidence of "Ambro" or that it is specifically an embroidery machine.
Only external appearance/parts are described; no run-test, stitch quality, or wear measurements were reported.
No stitch test results, tension/bobbin performance, or sample output were shown.

risks.risk: Whether it actually powers on and runs smoothly (motor/drive health).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powering on and running at low and medium speed with the needle moving continuously.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Stitch quality may be poor even if it runs (tension, bobbin winding, alignment).
risks.proof: A clip showing a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch on fabric, plus a close-up of the underside/bobbin thread balance.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing adjustment/repair for stitch quality.

risks.risk: Missing or incorrect accessories (pedal, power cable, needle/presser foot, bobbin, manual).
risks.proof: A photo/clip laying out all included items: pedal, power cable, needles, bobbins, presser feet, and any manual.

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical wear/damage (belt/drive parts, feed dogs condition, cracks, rust).
risks.proof: A close-up video of the belt/drive area (or underside) and feed dogs, plus inspection of the metal body for cracks/rust.

risks.risk: Identity mismatch: witness reports "AIG BROTHER" and does not confirm embroidery capability or exact model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s nameplate/model label and any embroidery-specific attachments/controls (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used Brother-type sewing machine with unknown embroidery capability.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the nameplate/model label (front/back) showing exact model and brand text.
Send a video of power-on and continuous running (needle moving) with the pedal.
Send a stitch test video: straight stitch and zigzag stitch on fabric, including a close-up of the underside.
List and show all included accessories (pedal, power cable, needles, bobbins, presser feet, manual).
Send close-ups of feed dogs and the belt/drive area (or underside) to check wear/rust/cracks.
response.reason: The witness confirms the machine’s external type/brand text and visible parts, but key value drivers (working condition, stitch quality, completeness, and exact model/embroidery capability) are not verifiable from the report. Proof is needed before a reliable price can be set.
